text:
Alex: Quick async standup — canary for feature 'gatekeeper' rolled out at 6:00pm PT. What I did: kicked off canary (v2.4.0), ran smoke tests, validated basic e2e flows. Blockers: saw a small redis timeout spike (~0.5% of requests) at 18:07. Today: watching metrics, prepping rollback runbook, will open PR for a retry/backoff tweak. @Priya @Sam

Priya: Looking at traces now — found 3 traces with kv-store timeout around 18:07. Autoscaler didn’t kick because CPU stayed below threshold. I’ll temporarily lower the autoscale threshold for the canary (70% -> 60%) and keep traffic at 10% for another hour. Left a note in the runbook.

DeployBot: canary-deploy/gatekeeper v2.4.0 started at 1790123456. current_traffic=10% | health=passing | rollout_id=r-9a7b

Sam: re infra — lowering threshold sounds fine. Can we also gate the feature flag to internal-first for the next 2h? If so, set `.rollout.stage=internal` then flip to external. @Jordan do we have request logs to correlate with the redis spikes?

Jordan: Logs are streaming. I spun up a short dashboard: /dashboards/canary/gatekeeper (shows p95 latency, redis.error_rate). Added alert: redis.timeout_rate > 0.2% -> #eng-oncall. Muted the noisy burst alert we saw.

Alex: Thanks — I opened PR #2314 with a retry/backoff tweak (small change). Needs one more review before we consider bumping traffic. @Priya can you take a look?

Priya: On it — will review in ~30m. Left a comment about tagging metrics for the new RPC path.

Sam: Note for rollback: use `deploy-tool rollback r-9a7b --force` then flip the feature flag back to `variant=previous`. I added step-by-step under playbooks/canary-rollbacks.md.

Jordan: After increasing the concurrency cap on the cache client the spike subsided. p95 dropped from ~420ms -> ~210ms for the affected flows. Continuing to watch for regressions.

Alex: Update: canary at 10% for 45m, no further regressions other than the brief redis burst which auto-resolved after the cap bump. Plan: ramp to 25% in 5–10m unless anyone objects.

Priya: No objections from infra side. I’ll start the 25% ramp at +5m and keep autoscale threshold adjusted for the next hour.

Sam: 👍 Ping me if you need a rollback or extra capacity.

Jordan: Will post a quick post-ramp summary in 30m with updated graphs.
